import base64 import hashlib import hmac import os _ALGORITHM = "scrypt" _N = 2 ** 14 _R = 8 _P = 1 _SALT_BYTES = 16 _DKLEN = 32 def hash_password(password: str) -> str: """Return a hash of password, as a string, to be stored in the users table when an account is created. Use only the Python standard library. The returned string has the format: scrypt$$$

$$ """ if not isinstance(password, str): raise TypeError("password must be a string") salt = os.urandom(_SALT_BYTES) dk = hashlib.scrypt( password.encode("utf-8"), salt=salt, n=_N, r=_R, p=_P, dklen=_DKLEN, maxmem=64 * 1024 * 1024, ) return "$".join( ( _ALGORITHM, str(_N), str(_R), str(_P), base64.b64encode(salt).decode("ascii"), base64.b64encode(dk).decode("ascii"), ) ) def verify_password(password: str, stored: str) -> bool: """Check a password against a string produced by hash_password.""" try: algorithm, n, r, p, salt_b64, hash_b64 = stored.split("$") if algorithm != _ALGORITHM: return False salt = base64.b64decode(salt_b64) expected = base64.b64decode(hash_b64) dk = hashlib.scrypt( password.encode("utf-8"), salt=salt, n=int(n), r=int(r), p=int(p), dklen=len(expected), maxmem=64 * 1024 * 1024, ) except (ValueError, TypeError): return False return hmac.compare_digest(dk, expected)
